assets.title: UPGRADES
assets.motif: The inventor's sign: dark indigo enamel and weathered bronze, small engraved blueprint compass marks and a tiny brass cog at the ends; restrained pale blue inlay.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one final 2D fantasy game merchant nameplate, transparent PNG, isolated UI asset.
Primary request: Custom painted and engraved lettering baked into the sign artwork itself, so it looks authored as one object. This is a replacement for plain runtime text placed on a generic frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing game's frame for visual language only (aged bronze/gold, almost-black blue interior); image 2 shows the actual game for palette and level of detail. Generate ONLY the isolated sign, no screenshot or game scene.
Style: finely painted dark-fantasy game UI, tangible old metal, restrained artisan detailing, crisp high-contrast warm ivory-gold letter faces with subtle bevel/shadow. Readable bold small-cap serif lettering, no ornate blackletter.
Composition: wide horizontal plaque, approximately 3.8:1 silhouette, front view with no perspective. Simple readable dark center. Merchant name as the dominant centered line in the upper half; the shop action as a smaller but very legible centered line in the lower half. Only modest merchant-specific ornament at the outer ends and border, keeping all lettering unobstructed. Both text lines part of the painted physical artifact. The lettering should occupy most of the usable width with very little empty space.
Output: true transparent background and genuine alpha around the complete plaque; no fake checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground shadow rectangle. Entire plaque inside canvas with small transparent safety margin. High resolution with clean edges. It will display around 300 pixels wide, so prioritize clear text over fine ornament.
Constraints: EXACTLY the two provided text strings, spelled exactly. No additional words, key letters, icons shaped like keyboard buttons, prompt symbols or watermark. Do not draw the interaction key; the game supplies that separately.
Merchant character: The inventor's sign: dark indigo enamel and weathered bronze, small engraved blueprint compass marks and a tiny brass cog at the ends; restrained pale blue inlay.
Text (verbatim), first line: "UPGRADES"
Text (verbatim), second line: "Improve your miner"
